People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- J. Sheridan Le Fanu, the author, died 1873.

First publication of the text used: 1869 (SE colophon: 'The Wyvern Mystery was published in 1869 by J. Sheridan Le Fanu.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1869, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1964.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1873 or earlier (the last to die, J. Sheridan Le Fanu, in 1873), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
